working_definition: One of three P15 optic lobe clusters identified by the authors as ganglion mother cells (dpn-, ase+); the authors add that it likely contains some immature neurons (only some cells express ase; lies between GMCs and immature neurons on UMAP).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Daughter cell formed through asymmetric division of a neuroblast, typically generating two postmitotic neurons.

justification: The authors call the cluster ganglion mother cells; FBbt has the generic ganglion mother cell term and no optic-lobe-specific GMC term. Flagged for verification because the authors themselves hedge that it likely contains some immature neurons.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00005149 ganglion mother cell (exact); verification flagged because of the authors' hedge.
